# VideoToQuiz AI / Universal SaaS
> Turn Any YouTube Video or Learning Resource into Interactive Quizzes & Flashcards in 10s.

## Core Features
- Automatic transcript and caption extraction
- Academic-level question generation with explanations
- One-click Anki (.apkg) & Markdown export
- Lifetime access and flexible credit bundles

## Technical Architecture
- Framework: Next.js 15 (App Router) + React 19 + TypeScript
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Payment: Compliant Merchant of Record with Visa/Mastercard/Apple Pay
- Privacy: GDPR & CCPA compliant
